LanguageData.MiliraXian_NeiyuNormal.label: Neiyu: Everyday Attire
LanguageData.MiliraXian_NeiyuNormal.description: The everyday attire worn by Neiyu's projection. It preserves the soft and light elegance of Milira fashion while still allowing her full freedom in battle and movement.
LanguageData.MX_Apparel_EarringsZhenzhu.label: Neiyu: Pearl Ornaments
LanguageData.MX_Apparel_EarringsZhenzhu.description: The pearl earrings worn by Neiyu, and one of the most recognizable parts of her projected appearance.
LanguageData.MX_QingheNormal.label: Qinghe: Everyday Attire
LanguageData.MX_QingheNormal.description: Qinghe's everyday attire. It bears a lotus pattern and a faint floral fragrance, with material and workmanship carefully designed by Qinghe herself.
LanguageData.MX_QingheHeaddress.label: Qinghe: Floral Headdress
LanguageData.MX_QingheHeaddress.description: The floral headdress Qinghe wears every day. Shaped after her beloved lotus, it is elegant and fresh, releasing a faint, comforting fragrance.
